The provided onboarding document does not contain information on customizing fonts or themes for the Hermes Agent web dashboard.

**Best Guess:**
* Hermes Agent's web UI may currently have fixed CSS/font bundles or limited support for custom theme YAML overrides. 
* Check your `~/.hermes/config.yaml` or dashboard asset directories to see if custom stylesheets can be injected, or consider submitting a feature request/PR to the repository to add support for standard/system font themes.
